gaps: per_page DEFAULT and MAXIMUM are unevidenced. Summarisers twice reported a default of 200 but produced no verbatim sentence, and a full-text reproduction request was declined on copyright grounds. The maximum is not stated anywhere. MUST be probed empirically against a live organisation before sizing any bulk extract.
No Retry-After header is documented for 429, and no back-off guidance is given. Retry strategy must be designed defensively (exponential back-off) without vendor guidance.

429 is overloaded across three distinct failure modes (per-minute 100, per-day plan quota, concurrency) distinguished only by body codes 44 / 45 / 1070. Body code 45's sample message says 'maximum call rate limit of 1000' while the prose says 100 - an unresolved internal contradiction in Zoho's own documentation.

The OAuth page's 16-scope list is DEMONSTRABLY INCOMPLETE: ERP.fixedasset appears on the Fixed Assets page but not in that list. Therefore the complete scope set can only be assembled by visiting all 78 resource-module pages. This lane sampled 4. A full scope sweep across all module pages is required before any least-privilege scope design is finalised.
Scope-to-module mapping is many-to-one (16+ scopes govern 78 modules) and is NOT derivable from module names. Each module page must be read for its own oauthscope lines.

The Zoho ERP OpenAPI zip (/erp/api/v3/openapi-all.zip, 429KB, HTTP 200) was NOT opened - downloading requires explicit user approval. This is the single highest-value unexploited artifact in the whole engagement: it would settle per_page limits, the complete scope list, every path, and every field name mechanically instead of by page-scraping. RECOMMEND the orchestrator obtain user approval to download and parse it.
Which modules and which events can trigger a workflow webhook is NOT documented. Trigger coverage per business object is unknown and must be verified in a live organisation.
The 'Default Payload' schema for workflow webhooks is undocumented, so an inbound receiver contract cannot be designed from documentation alone.
No verbatim Step6 'Calling An API' example was recoverable from the OAuth page; the Authorization header format was instead evidenced from the introduction page's curl sample.

Whether Zoho ERP is purchasable/available outside India is unresolved. Only the .in DC and only Standard/Premium plans are documented, strongly implying India-only, but no explicit availability statement was found.
PUT /invoice/{invoice_id}/customfields (singular 'invoice') may be a documentation typo or a genuine path quirk - unresolved, must be tested live.
GET /organizations pagination/filter behaviour is not documented; assumed unpaginated but unverified.
